verdict.rationale: The homepage attaches a rough basis and a disclaimer to its 98%+ approval figure ("across hundreds of cases. Past success doesn't guarantee future outcomes"), and the founders page also ties it to "hundreds of prior filings." The basis is only a vague count, though. Another Alma page advertises a different 99%+ rate with no basis at all. missing for 10: exact case counts, a stated time window, a methodology definition (e.g. how RFEs and withdrawals are counted), consistent figures across pages with a basis attached to every claim, and independent verification.
